My dear [Lord Bishop](/person/1479)
I shall be very grateful for permission to put in the Monthly Packet a copy of this excellent little paper -[^1]
[rest of page missing]
. . . recorded
I think too there is a little awkwardness in the piece about hospitality I do not think it will induce people to exercise it
[rest of page missing]
. . . will not be encouraged by it
Yours respectfully
C.M. Yonge


[^1]: The Rt. Rev. Allan Becher Webb (1839-1907), Bishop of Bloemfontein (1870-1883). The article was \'The Work of Women at Home for Foreign Missions (A Paper read by the Bishop of Bloemfontein at Rugby, July 8, 1875)\', MP ns 20 (November 1875) 397-403.
